description: StEER - 22 May 2019 JEFFERSON CITY, MO TORNADO: FIELD ASSESSMENT STRUCTURAL TEAM 1 (FAST-1) EARLY ACCESS RECONNAISSANCE REPORT (EARR) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Guirong (Grace) Yan, Missouri University of Science and Technology (mst.edu). At around 11:40 PM on Wednesday, May 22, 2019 an EF-3 tornado struck Jefferson City, the capital of the state of Missouri, causing extensive structural damage. The tornado formed near Eldon, MO and traveled from southwest to northeast for 19.5 miles before dissipating just east-northeast of Jefferson City, MO. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-qa2b-wz63. Keywords: Tornado; Reconnaissance; StEER; EARR. Published 2019-06-11. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
